description: This Java source file implements a service class 'LoanRescheduleRequestReadPlatformServiceImpl' that provides methods for retrieving loan reschedule request data from the database. It contains inner classes for mapping database rows to data objects, and includes methods to fetch individual or multiple reschedule requests, as well as reasons for rescheduling.

classes.name: LoanRescheduleRequestReadPlatformServiceImpl
classes.description: Service class handling database retrieval operations for loan rescheduling requests, including detailed row mappers for converting SQL result sets into domain data objects.

methods.name: readLoanRescheduleRequests
methods.description: Fetches all reschedule requests for a specific loan.

methods.name: readLoanRescheduleRequest
methods.description: Fetches a specific reschedule request by its ID.

methods.name: retrieveAllRescheduleReasons
methods.description: Retrieves all possible reschedule reasons based on a given reason code.

methods.name: retrieveAllRescheduleRequests
methods.description: Retrieves all reschedule requests filtered by command (approve/reject/all) and optionally by loan ID.
